title: Kashmir Delight
shortDescription: The essential Kashmir in six unhurried days — a night on a Dal Lake houseboat, the Gulmarg Gondola, Pahalgam's valleys and the glaciers of Sonmarg.
description: Kashmir Delight is our most-loved introduction to the valley, paced so you have time to linger. You'll start on the water, with a night aboard a traditional houseboat and a sunset shikara ride past floating gardens and lotus beds.

From Srinagar, private transfers take you up to the meadows of Gulmarg for a ride on one of the world's highest gondolas, out to the pine-forested Lidder valley at Pahalgam, and along the Sindh river to the snowfields of Sonmarg — before a last evening of Mughal gardens and kahwa back in the city.

price.note: Based on 2 adults in standard hotels. Flights to Srinagar not included.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Srinagar — houseboat welcome
itinerary.description: Our representative meets you at Srinagar airport and drives you to your houseboat on Dal Lake. After a welcome kahwa, settle in and enjoy a golden-hour shikara ride past the floating vegetable gardens, lotus beds and Char Chinar island.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg — meadow of flowers
itinerary.description: Drive through apple orchards and paddy fields to Gulmarg (approx. 2 hours). Ride the Gulmarg Gondola to Kongdoori for sweeping views of the Pir Panjal range, with the option to continue to Apharwat Peak. In winter, try skiing or a sledge ride.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg to Pahalgam — valley of shepherds
itinerary.description: Head to Pahalgam via the saffron fields of Pampore and the ruins of the 9th-century Avantipura temple. Arrive by afternoon and stroll along the Lidder river as the light falls on the pine forests.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam — Betaab, Aru & Chandanwari
itinerary.description: A full day exploring Pahalgam's three famous valleys by local cab — Betaab Valley's riverside meadows, the alpine village of Aru, and Chandanwari, starting point of the Amarnath Yatra, where snow lingers into early summer.

itinerary.title: Sonmarg day trip & Srinagar gardens
itinerary.description: Drive along the Sindh river to Sonmarg, the 'meadow of gold', with an optional pony ride to the Thajiwas Glacier. Return to Srinagar in the evening for a walk through the terraced Mughal gardens of Nishat and Shalimar.

itinerary.title: Farewell Kashmir
itinerary.description: After breakfast, time for last-minute shopping for pashmina, papier-mâché and dry fruits before your transfer to Srinagar airport.

Prepaid mobile SIMs from other states don't work in J&K; postpaid does
